title: City Water Supply Emergency Simulation
description: A virtual city is experiencing a water crisis. The user must strategically place oversized water bottles at key distribution points across the city to restore water supply to different districts. Each placement triggers a ripple effect showing water flow through the city blocks, and the user must achieve full coverage before a timer runs out.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a city water supply emergency simulation. Load VirtualCity.glb centered on the scene as the main environment and load WaterBottle.glb as a placeable supply object. Camera setup: use a perspective camera at an elevated isometric-like angle (position 30,40,30 looking at origin) with OrbitControls limited to prevent going below ground plane. Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light simulating late-afternoon sun (warm tone, casting shadows). On load, define 5 invisible circular hotspot zones scattered across the city at ground level, each marked with a subtle pulsing red ring (using a torus geometry with emissive red material). Display a HUD overlay showing: a 90-second countdown timer, a coverage meter (0-100%), and instruction text. Interaction flow: (1) User clicks a 'Deploy Water Supply' button in the HUD which spawns a water bottle clone floating attached to the mouse cursor via raycasting onto a ground plane. (2) User moves the bottle over the city; valid hotspots glow green when the bottle hovers near them. (3) User clicks to place the bottle at a hotspot, triggering a drop animation (bottle scales up slightly then settles with a bounce easing). (4) On placement, an expanding translucent blue ring radiates outward from the bottle simulating water distribution, and nearby city buildings within the ring gradually tint blue using material color lerping. (5) The coverage meter increases by 20% per successful placement. (6) After placing all 5 bottles (100% coverage), stop the timer, display a success overlay with completion time. If the timer expires before full coverage, show a failure message with a retry button. Each placed bottle should slowly rotate on its Y-axis. Use requestAnimationFrame for the game loop. Ensure all GLB models load via GLTFLoader from the Three.js CDN examples.
